arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنْ وَصَلْتَ طَاعَتَهُ بِطَاعَتِكَ، وَمَنْ جَعَلْتَ مَعْصِيَتَهُ كَمَعْصِيَتِكَ
transliteration: biḥaqqi man waṣaltat ṭāʿatahu biṭāʿatika wa-man jaʿalta maʿsiyatahu kamaʿsiyatika
english_text: By the right of him the obeying of whom Thou hast joined to obeying Thee, and by him the disobeying of whom Thou hast made like disobeying Thee!

arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنْ قَرَنْتَ مُوَالاَتَهُ بِمُوالاتِكَ، وَمَنْ نُطْتَ مُعَادَاتَهُ بِمُعَادَاتِكَ.
transliteration: biḥaqqi man qaranta muwālātahu bimuwālatika wa man nutta muʿaadatuhu bimuʿaadatika
english_text: And by the right of him whose friendship Thou hast bound to Thy friendship and by him whose enmity Thou hast linked to Thine enmity!

arabic_text: تَغَمَّدْنِي فِي يَوْمِيَ هَذَا بِمَا تَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ مَنْ جَارَ إلَيْكَ مُتَنَصِّلاً، وَعَاذَ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ تَائِباً،
transliteration: taghammadnī fī yawmiya hādhā bimā tataghammadu bihi man jāra ilayka mutanasṣilan waʿāḏa bi-istighfārika tāʾiban
english_text: Shield me in this day of mine, by that through which Thou shieldest him who prays fervently to Thee while disavowing and him who seeks refuge in Thy forgiveness while repenting!

arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّنِي بِمَا تَتَوَلَّى بِهِ أَهْلَ طَاعَتِكَ، وَالزُّلْفَى لَدَيْكَ، وَالْمَكَانَةِ مِنْكَ،
transliteration: wa tawallanī bimā tatawallā bihi ahl ṭāʿatika wa al-zulfā ladayka, wa al-makānatu minka
english_text: Attend to me with that through which Thou attendest to the people of obedience toward Thee, proximity to Thee, and rank with Thee!

arabic_text: وَتَوَحَّدْنِي بِمَا تَتَوَحَّدُ بِهِ مَنْ وَفى بِعَهْدِكَ، وَأَتْعَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِيْ ذَاتِكَ، وَأَجْهَدَهَا فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ،
transliteration: wa tawaḥhadnī bimā tatawaḥhadu bihī man wafā bi'ahdika wa-at'aba nafsahu fi dhatika, wa-ajhadaha fi marzatika
english_text: Single me out, as Thou singlest him out who fulfils Thy covenant, fatigues himself for Thy sake alone, and exerts himself in Thy good pleasure!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِتَفْرِيطِيْ فِي جَنْبِكَ، وَتَعَدِّي طَوْرِيْ فِي حُدودِكَ، وَمُجَاوَزَةِ أَحْكَامِكَ.
transliteration: walā tuʾākhidhnī bi tafritī fī janbik wa taʿaddi ṭawrī fī ḥudūdika, wa mujāwazati aḥkāmika
english_text: Take me not to task for my neglect in respect to Thee, my transgressing the limit in Thy bounds, and stepping outside Thy ordinances!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسْتَدْرِجْنِي بِإمْلائِكَ لِي اسْتِدْرَاجَ مَنْ مَنَعَنِي خَيْرَ مَا عِنْدَهُ، وَلَمْ يَشْرَكْكَ فِي حُلُولِ نِعْمَتِهِ بِي،
transliteration: wa lā tastadrijnī bi-imlā'ika lī istidrājaman manaʿanī khayra mā ʿindahu walammashrakkaka fee hulooli ni'matih biy
english_text: Draw me not on little by little by granting me a respite, like the drawing on little by little of him who withholds from me the good he has by not sharing with Thee in letting favour down upon me!

arabic_text: وَنَبِّهْنِي مِنْ رَقْدَةِ الْغَافِلِينَ، وَسِنَةِ الْمُسْرِفِينَ، وَنَعْسَةِ الْمَخْذُولِينَ.
transliteration: wa nabbihni min raqdah al-ghafilin wa sinati al-musrifin, wa na'sati al-makhdhulīn
english_text: Arouse me from the sleep of the heedless, the slumber of the prodigal, and the dozing of the forsaken!

arabic_text: وَخُذْ بِقَلْبِي إلَى مَا اسْتَعْمَلْتَ بِهِ القَانِتِيْنَ، وَاسْتَعْبَدْتَ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدِينَ، وَاسْتَنْقَذْتَ بِهِ الْمُتَهَاوِنِينَ،
transliteration: wa khudh biqalbi ila ma astaʿmalt bihi al-qanitīn wa astaʿbadta bihi al-mutaʿabbideen, wa istanqadhta bihi al-mutahawineen
english_text: Take my heart to that in which Thou hast employed the devout, enthralled the worshipers, and rescued the remiss!

arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنِي مِمَّا يُبَاعِدُنِي عَنْكَ، وَيَحُولُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ حَظِّي مِنْكَ، وَيَصُدُّنِي عَمَّا أُحَاوِلُ لَدَيْكَ.
transliteration: wa'a'ithni mimma yuba'iiduni 'anka wayaḥūlu baynī wa bayna ḥaẓẓī minka wa yasuddunī ʿammā uḥāwilu ladayka
english_text: Give me refuge from that which will keep me far from Thee, come between me and my share from Thee, and bar me from that which I strive for in Thee!

arabic_text: وَسَهِّلْ لِي مَسْلَكَ الْخَيْرَاتِ إلَيْكَ، وَالْمُسَابَقَةِ إلَيْهَا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتَ، وَالْمُشَاحَّةَ فِيهَا عَلَى مَا أَرَدْتَ.
transliteration: wasahhil li maslakal khayrati ilayk wal-musābaqati ilayhā min ḥaythu amarta wal-mushāḥḥata fīhā ʿalā mā aradta
english_text: Make easy for me the road of good deeds toward Thee, racing to them from where Thou hast commanded, and coveting them as Thou desirest!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَمْحَقْنِي فِيمَنْ تَمْحَقُ مِنَ الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِمَا أَوْعَدْتَ،
transliteration: walā tamḥaqnī fīman tamḥaq min al-mustaḫiffīna bimā awʿadta
english_text: Efface me not along with those whom Thou effacest for thinking lightly of what Thou hast promised!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي مَعَ مَنْ تُهْلِكُ مِنَ الْمُتَعَرِّضِينَ لِمَقْتِكَ،
transliteration: wa lā tuhliknī maʿa man tuhliku min al-mutaʿarridīna li-maqtika
english_text: Destroy me not with those whom Thou destroyest for exposing themselves to Thy hate!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُتَبِّرْني فِيمَنْ تُتَبِّرُ مِنَ الْمُنْحَرِفِينَ عَنْ سُبُلِكَ.
transliteration: walā tutabbirnī fīman tutabbiru minal munḥarifīna ʿan subulika
english_text: Annihilate me not among those whom Thou annihilatest for deviating from Thy roads!

arabic_text: وَنَجِّنِيْ مِنْ غَمَرَاتِ الْفِتْنَةِ، وَخَلِّصْنِي مِنْ لَهَوَاتِ الْبَلْوى، وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْ أَخْذِ الاِمْلاءِ،
transliteration: wa najjinī min ghamarātil fitnah wa khal-lis-ni min lahawatil balwaa waajirnii min akhẓi al-imlaa'i
english_text: Deliver me from the floods of trial, save me from the gullets of affliction, and grant me sanctuary from being seized by respite!

arabic_text: وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَدُوٍّ يُضِلُّنِي، وَهَوىً يُوبِقُنِي، وَمَنْقَصَة تَرْهَقُنِي.
transliteration: wa ḥul bayni wa bayna ʿaduwwin yuḍillunī wa hawān yūbiqunī, wa manqasah tarhiqunī
english_text: Come between me and the enemy who misguides me, the caprice which ruins me, and the failing which overcomes me!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي إعْرَاضَ مَنْ لاَ تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بَعْدَ غَضَبِكَ،
transliteration: wa lā tuʿriḍ ʿannī iʿrāḍa man lā tarḍā ʿanhu baʿda ghaḍabika
english_text: Turn not away from me with the turning away in wrath from one with whom Thou art not pleased!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُؤْيِسْنِي مِنَ الامَلِ فِيكَ، فَيَغْلِبَ عَلَيَّ الْقُنُوطُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: walā tuʾayyisnī min al-amal fīka, fayaghliba ʿalayya al-qunūṭu min raḥmatika
english_text: Let me not lose heart in expecting from Thee, lest I be overcome by despair of Thy mercy!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَمْنَحْنِي بِمَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لِيْ بِهِ، فَتَبْهَظَنِي مِمَّا تُحَمِّلُنِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِ مَحَبَّتِكَ،
transliteration: walā tamnaḥnī bimā lā ṭāqata lī bihī fatabhazhanī mimmā tuḥammilunīhi min faḍli maḥabbatika
english_text: Grant me not that which I cannot endure, lest Thou weighest me down with the surplus of Thy love which Thou loadest upon me!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُرْسِلْنِي مِنْ يَدِكَ إرْسَالَ مَنْ لاَ خَيْرَ فِيهِ، وَلاَ حَاجَةَ بِكَ إلَيْهِ، وَلاَ إنابَةَ لَهُ،
transliteration: walā tur-silnī min yadika ir-sāla man lā khayra fīhī wa-lā ḥājata bika ʾilayhi, wa-lā inābata lah
english_text: Send me not from Thy hand, the sending of him who possesses no good, toward whom Thou hast no need, and who turns not back [to Thee]!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَرْمِ بِيَ رَمْيَ مَنْ سَقَطَ مِنْ عَيْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَمَنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْخِزْيُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
transliteration: walā tarmi biya ramya man saqata min ʿayni riʿāyatika wa mani ashtamala ʿalayhi al-khizyu min ʿindika
english_text: Cast me not with the casting of him who has fallen from the eye of Thy regard and been wrapped in degradation from Thee!

arabic_text: بَلْ خُذْ بِيَدِيْ مِنْ سَقْطَةِ الْمُتَرَدِّدِينَ، وَوَهْلَةِ الْمُتَعَسِّفِيْنَ، وَزَلّةِ الْمَغْرُورِينَ، وَوَرْطَةِ الْهَالِكِينَ.
transliteration: bal khudh biyadi min saqţati almutaraddidin wa wahlati al-mutaʿassisfiin, wa zallati al-maghruuriin, wa wartaṭati al-haalikiin
english_text: Rather take my hand [and save me] from the falling of the stumblers, the disquiet of the deviators, the slip of those deluded, and the plight of the perishers!

arabic_text: وَعَافِنِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَيْتَ بِهِ طَبَقَاتِ عَبِيدِكَ وَإمآئِكَ، وَبَلِّغْنِي مَبَالِغَ مَنْ عُنِيتَ بِهِ، وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَرَضِيتَ عَنْهُ، فَأَعَشْتَهُ حَمِيداً، وَتَوَفَّيْتَهُ سَعِيداً،
transliteration: wa'aafini mimma ibtalayta bihi ṭabaqāti ʿibādika wa imā'ika wa ballighnī mabāligha man ʿunīta bihī, wa anʿamta ʿalayhī, wa raḍīta ʿanhu fa'aʿashtahu ḥamīdan, wa tawaffaytahu saʿīdan
english_text: Release me from that with which Thou hast afflicted the ranks of Thy servants and handmaids and make me reach the utmost degrees of him about whom Thou art concerned, towards whom Thou showest favour, and with whom Thou art pleased, so that Thou lettest him live as one praiseworthy and takest him to Thee as one felicitous!

arabic_text: وَطَوِّقْنِي طَوْقَ الاِقْلاَعِ عَمَّا يُحْبِطُ الْحَسَنَاتِ، وَيَذْهَبُ بِالْبَرَكَاتِ،
transliteration: wa ṭawwiq-nī ṭawq al-iqlāʿ ʿammā yuḥbiṭu al-ḥasanāt wayadhhabu bil-barakāti
english_text: Collar me with the collar of abstaining from that which makes good deeds fail and takes away blessings!

arabic_text: وَأَشْعِرْ قَلْبِيَ الازْدِجَارَ عَنْ قَبَائِحِ السَّيِّئاتِ، وَفَوَاضِحِ الْحَوْبَاتِ،
transliteration: wa-ashʿir qalbiya al-azdijara ʿan qaba'ihis sayyi'at wafawāḍiḥi al-ḥawbāt
english_text: Impart to my heart restraint before ugly works of evil and disgraceful misdeeds!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَشْغَلْنِي بِمَا لاَ أُدْرِكُهُ إلاَّ بِكَ عَمَّا لا َ يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّي غَيْرُهُ،
transliteration: walā tašġalnī bimā lā udriku-hu illā bika, ʿammā lā yurḍīka ʿannī ġayru-hu
english_text: Divert me not by that which I cannot reach except through Thee from doing that which alone makes Thee pleased with me!

arabic_text: وَانْزَعْ مِنْ قَلْبِي حُبَّ دُنْيَا دَنِيَّة تَنْهى عَمَّا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَصُدُّ عَنِ ابْتِغَآءِ الْوَسِيلَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَتُذْهِلُ عَنِ التَّقَرُبِ مِنْكَ،
transliteration: wa anzʿa min qalbī ḥubba dunyā dunyātan tuhannī ʿammā ʿindaka wa taṣuddu ʿani ibtiġāʾi al-wasīlah ilayka, wa tudh-hilu ʿani al-taqarrub minak
english_text: Root out from my heart the love of this vile world, which keeps from everything which is with Thee, bars from seeking the mediation to Thee, and distracts from striving for nearness to Thee!

arabic_text: وَزَيِّنَ لِيَ التَّفَرُّدَ بِمُنَاجَاتِكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ،
transliteration: wa zayyina liya at-tafarruda bimunajatika billayli wan-nahari
english_text: Embellish for me solitude in prayer whispered to Thee by night and by day!

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي عِصْمَةً تُدْنِينِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَتَقْطَعُنِي عَنْ رُكُوبِ مَحَارِمكَ، وَتَفُكُّنِي مِنْ أَسْرِ الْعَظَائِمِ،
transliteration: wa hab li ʿismatan tudnini min khashyatika wa taqṭaʿunī ʿan rukūbi mahārimika wa tafukkuni min asri l-'adha'im
english_text: Give me a preservation which will bring me close to dread of Thee, cut me off from committing things made unlawful by Thee, and spare me from captivation by dreadful sins!

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي التَّطْهِيرَ مِنْ دَنَسِ الْعِصْيَانِ، وَأَذْهِبْ عَنِّي دَرَنَ الْخَطَايَا، وَسَرْبِلْنِي بِسِرْبالِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَرَدِّنِي رِدَآءَ مُعَافاتِكَ،
transliteration: wa hab li al-tat'hīr min danas al-'iṣyān wa-adhhib ʿanni darana al-khataaya wa sarbilni bisirbal `afiyyatika waraddini ridā'a mu'āfātika
english_text: Give me purification from the defilement of disobedience, take away from me the filth of offenses, dress me in the dress of Thy well-being, cloak me in the cloak of Thy release,
